name: SunTech Medical Inc
old_description: The Vet40 is here! Experience the next generation in veterinary monitoring — available now.
about:
SunTech Medical Inc operates from Morrisville, North Carolina. The company has accumulated more than 30 years of blood pressure data, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been publicly stated.

The company develops and manufactures clinical-grade non-invasive blood pressure (NIBP) monitoring systems for human and veterinary use. Its product lines include the Vet40 veterinary monitor and OEM NIBP modules designed for integration into third-party medical devices. Details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not provided.

SunTech serves the medical device and veterinary markets, with referenced partners including CU Medical Systems, Danish Aerospace, and Digicare Biomedical. The company also participates in medical device trade shows and maintains a medical advisory board.

SunTech emphasizes its legacy of blood pressure expertise, stating that three decades of data allow it to distinguish true clinical signals from artifacts. The firm positions its technology as clinical-grade, targeting accuracy and reliability in both human and animal health applications.
